normalize — SHAPE2D descriptor op

• Data kinds: efdmodel → matrix

• Call: import fullseye as fs; fs.ledger.normalize(model, size_invariant=True) (to call the implementation directly, import fourierdesc; fourierdesc.normalize(model, size_invariant=True); from the registry, opsshape2d.get("normalize"))

Usage

Converts EFD coefficients into the coefficients of the "canonical pose" (aligned with respect to the 1st harmonic).

Kuhl–Giardina canonicalisation: (1) remove the arbitrariness of the start point using the phase of the 1st harmonic, (2) rotate the long axis of the 1st ellipse onto the reference axis to align the orientation, (3) divide by the long-axis length of the 1st harmonic to align the size. Intended for "canonical-pose reconstruction", such as overlaying or averaging several shapes.

Caution (honest): for shapes whose 1st harmonic is nearly circular (long axis ≈ short axis), the phase (theta/psi) is ill-conditioned and unstable. For invariant matching, do not use this function; use invariants / descriptor_distance (based on singular values).
